findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "import_deck" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: upgrade_precon, reduce_deck_cost, repair_deck, change_deck_bracket, import_deck · Private data: import_deck · Public sink: build_mana_base.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: upgrade_precon, reduce_deck_cost, repair_deck, change_deck_bracket, import_deck · Private data: import_deck · Public sink: build_mana_base

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_commanders" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
